parties.petitioner: M/S N.N. Global Mercantile Private Limited
parties.respondent: M/S Indo Unique Flame Ltd. & ORS

summary: Separability of arbitration agreement from unstamped contract; Stamp Act Section 35 bar not applicable to arbitration clause; Kompetenz-Kompetenz affirmed under Section 16(1); minimal judicial interference standard; reference made to Constitution Bench regarding whether stamp duty requirement invalidates arbitration agreement pending payment; distinction between Section 11(6A) existence versus enforceability; Contract Act 1872 Section 2(h) enforcement analysis applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 s.5, s.8, s.11, s.11(6A), s.16(1), s.45
Indian Stamp Act, 1899 s.3, s.33, s.35, s.38, s.40
final_judgment: Reference made to Constitution Bench; issue referred: whether Stamp Act Section 35 bar renders arbitration agreement unenforceable pending stamp payment on main contract.
